# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please email **security@vaines.org** with the details below. Do not open a public issue for security problems.

Please include:

- A description of the vulnerability and its impact
- Steps to reproduce, or a proof of concept
- The affected version(s) and configuration
- Any suggested fix or mitigation, if you have one

## What to Expect

- We will acknowledge your report within **7 business days**.
- We will confirm whether the issue is accepted and keep you updated on progress.
- We aim to release a fix or mitigation within **30 days** of confirming the issue, depending on its complexity.
- We will coordinate the public disclosure date with you once a fix is available.
- With your permission, we will credit you in the release notes or security advisory.

## Good-Faith Research

We will not pursue action against researchers who act in good faith: who report promptly, avoid privacy violations, data destruction and service disruption, and give us reasonable time to fix the issue before disclosing it.

## Out of Scope

- Issues in third-party dependencies that are already publicly known (please report those upstream)
- Reports from automated scanners without a demonstrated impact
- Social engineering and physical attacks
